sample_unit: LLMs tested on musculoskeletal rehabilitation exam questions and two clinical cases
models_evaluated: 10 LLMs (Chinese and English) including general-purpose models

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on musculoskeletal rehabilitation exam questions
links.effect: Only ERNIE Bot X1 Turbo and Doubao 1.5 pro exceeded 90% accuracy; other LLMs performed lower, so exam-style benchmark performance varied widely across models.
links.quote: In the first test, only ERNIE Bot X1 Turbo and Doubao 1.5 pro had accuracy rates of over 90%, and Chinese LLMs had significantly fewer incorrect questions than English LLMs (9.6% vs. 14.8%, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs as exam preparation aids for rehabilitation therapists
Selecting local-language LLMs for local-language clinical questions

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and competence of various LLMs on musculoskeletal rehabilitation questions and their performance assisting primary therapists preparing for examinations, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
